purpose: Provide a quick review rubric for the next PowerRequestOverride response-side and UMPO message reacquire artifacts.

outcome_mapping.review_rule: Choose this outcome when the response-side stdout exposes CmQueryValueKey, ZwQueryValueKey, NtQueryValueKey, or a clearly leaf-specific *Reg* helper in the immediate path.
outcome_mapping.next_move: Stay kernel-side and capture the exact read/apply chain.

outcome_mapping.review_rule: Choose this outcome when the response-side stdout shows Process/Service/Driver branching or stable request-bit semantics without an exact read helper.
outcome_mapping.next_move: Document the consumer semantics but keep the record blocked on exact reader binding.

outcome_mapping.review_rule: Choose this outcome when the strongest new clue comes from PopUmpoSendPowerMessage transport or payload handling rather than the response-side path.
outcome_mapping.next_move: Pivot to a bounded power-service or powrprof follow-up.

outcome_mapping.review_rule: Choose this outcome when both reacquired paths are mostly wrappers, allocator/requester scaffolding, or queue plumbing.
outcome_mapping.next_move: Follow only the first non-wrapper callee and stop if the family broadens.

red_flags: Missing stdout for one of the two required reacquire artifacts.
Only wildcard symbol output is present and no uf disassembly body is retained.
non_goals: Do not treat another powercfg materialization cycle as progress for this lane.
Do not treat generic callback or queue plumbing alone as reader-binding proof.
Do not reopen a broad *PowerRequest*Reg* hunt before reviewing these two reacquired artifacts.
